title: PvP Crosshair
description: A custom PvP crosshair pack that improves aim visibility and provides a cleaner, more precise targeting experience in combat.
body: This custom PvP crosshair resource pack replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a cleaner and more focused design for competitive gameplay. It is made to improve aim consistency, reduce visual distraction, and help with faster target tracking during PvP fights. Perfect for Crystal PvP, sword PvP, and general competitive play where precision matters.
